firstPlayerRule: The oldest player receives the crown and is first to choose a character card.
houseFallback: Choose randomly among the tied oldest players.
clarifications: Choosing characters proceeds to the left. Actual character turns follow ascending rank, so the crown holder does not necessarily take the first character action.
In two- and three-player games, players choose two characters; the crown holder still makes the first choice.
